summary: Request Miro Enterprise seats for Design Systems team and review contract for SSO/SCIM needs
description:
Issue summary: Design Systems requests 40 Miro Enterprise seats to consolidate whiteboarding, component planning, and customer-facing workshop artifacts.

Impact: The team is currently spread across three paid Miro orgs leading to fragmented boards and duplicated licenses. Consolidation will reduce overhead, enable org-wide templates, and allow SSO/SCIM provisioning for security auditing.

Requirements:
- 40 full Miro Enterprise seats plus 10 guest collaborator seats (30-day ramp).
- SSO via Okta (SAML) and SCIM provisioning for automated user lifecycle.
- Contract must include SOC2 Type II attestation and data residency notes for eu-west if requested later.
- Billing to be charged to cost center ENG-DESIGN (PO required).

Acceptance criteria:
- Procurement obtains Miro quote and contract redline with enterprise SSO/SCIM enabled.
- Legal confirms standard terms or flags required changes.
- IT/Security confirms SCIM integration plan and retention/SCIM attributes.
- Seats provisioned and a sample board/template shared with Design Systems within 5 business days of contract execution.
business_justification: Design Systems will centralize cross-org design ops and reduce board duplication. Consolidation supports PLG initiatives (templates, onboarding flows) and reduces manual seat management overhead for IT.
approval_chain: Design Manager -> Eng Finance -> Legal -> Security
steps_for_procurement: 1) Request formal quote from Miro sales (attach internal PO template). 2) Send contract to Legal for redline. 3) Security to review SOC2 and SCIM claims. 4) Once approved, Procurement to issue PO and confirm billing. 5) IT to configure SCIM/Okta mapping and provision accounts.
notes_to_legal: Please review data processing terms and ensure there is either a DPA or equivalent clause. Confirm whether Miro supports EU data residency guarantees for future addendum. Flag any non-standard indemnity/limitation clauses.
